record.context_brief: Parallel tension field of the identity map
record.original_question: For a statistical manifold, can one identify and study those for which the tension field of the identity map is parallel, where the paper notes that for the identity map one has tau(id) = tr_g K with K = nabla - nabla^g?

evidence.quote: Indeed, the tension field of the identity map of a statistical manifold is τ(id) = trgK, where K = ∇ − ∇g is the difference tensor field. Thus the so-called apolarity of a statistical manifold is characterized as the statistical harmonicity of the identity map. Based on these observations, we propose here • Investigate statistical manifolds with parallel τ(id).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M, g, 
abla)$ be a statistical manifold, that is, a smooth manifold $M$ equipped with a Riemannian metric $g$ and a torsion-free affine connection $
abla$ such that $
abla g$ is totally symmetric in its three arguments. Let $
abla^g$ denote the Levi-Civita connection of $g$, and define the difference tensor field $K = 
abla - 
abla^g$, a $(1,2)$-tensor field on $M$.

The tension field of the identity map $\mathrm{id}: (M, g, 
abla) 	o (M, g, 
abla)$, viewed in the framework of statistical harmonic maps, is given by
$$	au(\mathrm{id}) = \mathrm{tr}_g K,$$
which is a vector field on $M$. The statistical manifold is called apolar (i.e., the identity map is statistically harmonic) when $	au(\mathrm{id}) = 0$.

Problem: Characterize and study the class of statistical manifolds $(M, g, 
abla)$ for which the tension field $	au(\mathrm{id}) = \mathrm{tr}_g K$ is parallel, i.e.,
$$
abla^g (\mathrm{tr}_g K) = 0$$
(equivalently, study statistical manifolds whose mean difference vector field is parallel with respect to the Levi-Civita connection). Identify nontrivial examples beyond the apolar case, derive structural consequences of this condition, and classify such statistical manifolds under natural additional hypotheses (e.g., constant curvature, dual flatness, homogeneity).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as a proposed open research direction in a recent (September 2025) collection of open problems in information geometry from the FDIG 2025 workshop. Related work on statistical harmonicity and biharmonicity of identity maps exists, but no classification or general structural result for statistical manifolds with parallel τ(id) = tr_g K appears to be available.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in information geometry: a discussion at FDIG 2025
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open problems including a proposal to investigate statistical manifolds with parallel τ(id), where τ(id) = tr_g K is the tension field of the identity map.
status_evidence.claim: The investigation of statistical manifolds with parallel τ(id) is explicitly proposed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Statistical Biharmonicity of Identity Maps
status_evidence.snippet: Studies harmonicity and biharmonicity properties of the identity map of statistical manifolds in terms of the difference tensor K.
status_evidence.claim: Related questions about harmonicity of the identity map have been studied, but parallelism of τ(id) is not classified.
